title: field_ops.order.completed v1
description: Emitted when a field order moves to status='completed' after the technician closes custody. Source publisher: alebrije-mod-field-ops-ex Workers.EventPublisher, relaying the [:alebrije_field_ops, :order, :completed] telemetry event from Orders.emit_status_event/2; fields live under `data` (build_envelope/3). 2026-10-20, additive (README §6, relaxing constraints): `kind` is no longer a closed enum because kinds are configurable per tenant (ADR-127, KindConfigCache), and `completed_at` is optional because producers before field-ops 0.0.114 did not send it; status, previous_status, context_id, share_token, tracking_link and m_count are documented.

appointment_id.description: The agenda appointment the order came from (agenda-ex creates a pickup_sample order from a lab_domicile appointment); null for any other order. Agenda closes its appointment on this event (ADR-37 §18.3 «Cierre con el módulo de origen»). Added 2026-10-21, field-ops 0.0.128, additive.

kind.description: Work type. Configurable per tenant and context (ADR-127, KindConfigCache); the platform defaults are pickup_sample, delivery, inspection and service_call, but consumers must tolerate any value.

share_token.description: Public tracking token (a credential: do not log).

external_ref.description: External system reference (e.g. upstream ticket / order number).

completed_at.description: Timestamp the technician marked the work order as done.

duration_seconds.description: Elapsed time from assignment to completion.
